gui.mekanism_magic.retained.wither_roses: Optional: keep 36 wither roses for offering bonus output; roses are not consumed per batch

jei.mekanism_magic.forbidden.preparation: Per operation: one sand + tool wear
Retains tool; also outputs soulless sand
Retain one native Soul Extractor; each operation applies native 1-durability wear.
Each soul sand produces exactly one Soul and one Soulless Sand.

Empty catcher shown as an illustration only. Install a filled compatible container or valid spawn egg as a retained specimen. Empty containers, players and unresolved random entity pools are not supported.
Consumes one empty tube and 3,000 buffered blood. Each simulation yields default type max-health × 20, capped at 3,000; a cycle is not necessarily enough for one full tube.
Deposit manually; unused XP is withdrawable
Consumes one glass bottle and 15 stored player XP points. Produces a native Bottle o' Enchanting; throwing it retains vanilla random XP and no nearby player is automatically drained.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.soul_extractor.to: Retained tool: insert one native soul extractor. Each operation applies native 1-durability wear; pipes cannot extract it.
gui.mekanism_magic.simulated_blood.no_sa: Needs a creature or spawn egg
tooltip.mekanism_magic.simulated_blood.s: Retain a captured creature or valid spawn egg as a specimen. Powered simulation consumes neither, spawns or attacks no world entity, and respects the blood blacklist.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.drygmy.sample: Retain a mob jar, compatible filled creature container or valid spawn egg. Each slot counts as one sample, regardless of stack size; native Drygmy blacklist rules still apply.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.simulated_blood.t: Native empty test tube; output is filled with exactly 3,000 blood.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.simulated_blood.o: Fixed full blood test tube with native essence components; draining returns the empty tube.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.simulated_blood.b: Retains partial-tube blood. Simulation produces blood only, not loot or XP.
jei.mekanism_magic.forbidden.fire_contex: Advanced fire consumes real media and burns over time, not one item per recipe. Normal fire needs no medium; stronger fire also handles weaker recipes.
jei.mekanism_magic.forbidden.retained_en: Install in an enhancer slot; retained rather than consumed per operation.
jei.mekanism_magic.forbidden.residue_rul: Advanced fire has a %2$s chance per completion to yield 1 residue unit. This result requires %1$s accumulated units, not every operation.
jei.mekanism_magic.forbidden.residue_fir: Normal fire produces no residue. Native fire and enhancer rules still apply.
jei.mekanism_magic.forbidden.minimum_fir: Minimum fire: %s; a dash means this fire does not qualify.
jei.mekanism_magic.forbidden.base_timing: Times are unupgraded base values; actual speed and energy follow Mekanism upgrades.
jei.mekanism_magic.forbidden.modifier_el: Examples pass native eligibility checks. Existing modifiers, durability properties or enchantments can still make an actual stack ineligible.
jei.mekanism_magic.forbidden.component_r: Native assembly of the paired example. Actual results depend on the real input components; example defaults never overwrite them.
jei.mekanism_magic.forbidden.retained_co: The installed native forge core supplies tier eligibility; it is not consumed per recipe.
jei.mekanism_magic.forbidden.core_upgrad: This installed core is being upgraded internally. It is not the main ingredient and must not be requested repeatedly from an item network.
The upgraded core is installed inside the machine. No extractable forge is produced and the machine block is not replaced.
jei.mekanism_magic.forbidden.starter_con: A real ritual starter: native RITUAL_STARTER durability cost applies, including native enchantment and modifier behavior.
jei.mekanism_magic.forbidden.essence_rul: Shows the native four-essence debit. Enhancers may change the start threshold; their effects are not misreported as a debit discount. Creative Magic waives only essence, not materials, FE or starter rules.
jei.mekanism_magic.aura_fuel.flower: Overworld Aura only; repeated flower types lose efficiency
jei.mekanism_magic.aura_fuel.components: Actual yield depends on firework or potion components
jei.mekanism_magic.aura_fuel.consume: Consumes the entire item; no FE required
tooltip.mekanism_magic.magic_storage_cel: Shared storage for Source and typed Aura; no items or fluids
%s units per byte, rounded up separately per resource
tooltip.mekanism_magic.magic_source_pipe: Transfers Source; other supported magic resources use independent channels
item.mekanism_magic.source_link_tool.sec: Right-click a machine or Source Jar to create the link
item.mekanism_magic.source_link_tool.cle: Sneak-right-click to cancel; with no selection, clears supported links
item.mekanism_magic.source_link_tool.con: Ran this block's native connection clear action
item.mekanism_magic.source_link_tool.sou: Cleared this machine's saved Source Jar links
item.mekanism_magic.source_link_tool.not: There is no selection to cancel and this block cannot clear links
item.mekanism_magic.source_link_tool.wro: Source links cannot cross dimensions; selection cancelled
item.mekanism_magic.source_link_tool.uns: Select one Source-consuming machine and one original Source Jar
upgrade.mekanism_magic.creative_magic.de: Installs through Mekanism's native upgrade system, prevents recipe magic-resource consumption, and disables unnecessary Source input.
item.mekanism_magic.creative_source_upgr: Installs through Mekanism's native upgrade input slot.
Recipes no longer consume their magic resource, and external Source input is disabled.
Does not affect FE use, processing speed, or the original Creative Upgrade.
jei.mekanism_magic.catalyst_identifier.i: Scanned from the currently loaded Ars Nouveau imbuement recipes. Drag a variant into the imbuement recipe lock to select its catalyst context.
The catalyst identifier is stored in the AE pattern as recipe context, but is not planned, extracted, or dispatched as a material input.
item.mekanism_magic.ultimate_mini_ritual: Requires the four highest-tier Marid pentacles: craft, possess, summon, and summon unbound Marid
Spawns the target with a 1/%s chance; otherwise spawns a chicken
Will be bound to the placing player
item.mekanism_magic.mini_ritual.bind: Hold a ritual projection for the same pentacle offhand and use in the air to bind that recipe
item.mekanism_magic.mini_ritual.capture: Right-click a complete ground pentacle's bowl or structure block to capture it
item.mekanism_magic.mini_ritual.capture_: Nested pentacles select the highest complete structure and preserve actual materials and candle counts
item.mekanism_magic.mini_ritual.saved_ma: Original materials, block states and candle counts are retained and restored on deployment
item.mekanism_magic.mini_ritual.capture_: Capture a complete pentacle first; a blank cannot create its materials from a projection
item.mekanism_magic.mini_ritual.same_pen: Only a recipe for the same pentacle can be bound; the packed structure cannot be changed

gui.mekanism_magic.chalk_module: Expand or collapse the chalk module
gui.mekanism_magic.dictionary_module: Expand or collapse the Dictionary of Spirits module
jei.mekanism_magic.mini_ritual.info: Capture a complete ground pentacle with a Blank Mini Ritual, selecting the highest complete nested structure. Alternatively, supply the assembler with its materials, unique dye combination and required chalk.
jei.mekanism_magic.ritual.dictionary_req: Before using an unbound book, place a Dictionary of Spirits in the machine's dictionary slot. The dictionary is not consumed.
jei.mekanism_magic.ritual.bound_book_alt: You can also insert the corresponding bound book manually.
jei.mekanism_magic.ritual.dynamic_output: View uses (default U) of the actual damaged tool or filled soul shard. This icon is explanatory and cannot be encoded as an output.
jei.mekanism_magic.ritual.exact_input_ou: The output retains the displayed input's full data. The pattern requires those exact input components.
jei.mekanism_magic.dynamic_recipe.exact_: A resolvable real input is required. View uses of the actual item before transferring this recipe.
jei.mekanism_magic.dynamic_recipe.stale_: The inputs or recipe changed. View the actual item's uses again before encoding its output.
jei.mekanism_magic.dynamic_recipe.termin: This pattern terminal has too few slots to encode every input and output.
jei.mekanism_magic.apparatus.input_hint: The output is assembled from this full input. View uses of a real item to preserve enchantments, bindings and coordinates.
jei.mekanism_magic.apparatus.exact_outpu: Assembled from the displayed exact inputs, including their data components.
jei.mekanism_magic.ritual.stable_miner_n: A miner's spirit name only affects display. This machine uses a consistent default name so AE can recognize outputs and chain recipes.
jei.mekanism_magic.ritual.stable_named_i: This machine keeps the recipe output's fixed spirit name instead of the activation book's random name. Other data components are retained.
jei.mekanism_magic.trade_weight: Random result weight: %s (shared pool for matching inputs)
jei.mekanism_magic.random_trade_no_patte: Probabilistic output cannot use AE crafting patterns; actual results can still enter the network
gui.mekanism_magic.config_hint: Use the configurator to change side modes
config.mekanism_magic.animations_enabled: Controls animated machine mechanisms, Drygmy displays, and Source/Aura flow inside magic pipes. Disabling it only changes client visuals; machine operation and resource transfer are unaffected.
config.mekanism_magic.force_working_anim: Shows working visuals on idle machines and empty Source/Aura pipes. This is only a client visual test and does not produce items, consume energy, or modify resource networks.
mekanism_magic.configuration.title: %s Configuration
gui.mekanism_magic.spirit_required: Requires an Occultism spirit egg or a supported container holding a spirit
chat.mekanism_magic.mekenergistics_too_o: Mek Energistics %s is too old for ME automation integration. Upgrade to %s or newer; the feature is disabled.
gui.mekanism_magic.aura_type_mismatch: Stored Aura type does not match this dimension
gui.mekanism_magic.not_enough_aura: Not enough Aura for the selected recipe
gui.mekanism_magic.offering.flower_ring: Internal offering; no external flower ring
jei.mekanism_magic.offering.ring: Processes internally without requiring or scanning an external flower ring
jei.mekanism_magic.offering.batch: One start item processes every complete recipe group in the input stack; no Aura cost
jei.mekanism_magic.offering.bonus: Optional: keep 36 wither roses in the internal catalyst slot for 4–8 black dye per batch. Roses are not consumed; normal processing needs none
tooltip.mekanism_magic.magic_source_pipe: Source and Aura use independent channels in the same pipe; resources are never converted
jei.mekanism_magic.tree_ritual.growth: Consumes one matching sapling internally. No planting, soil, light or growth-space checks
jei.mekanism_magic.tree_ritual.powder: Consumes 16 gold powder from the dedicated slot per operation; never places a ritual in the world
jei.mekanism_magic.tree_ritual.structure: Materials, sapling and gold powder are processed inside the machine; no external ritual structure
gui.mekanism_magic.animal_spawner.struct: Internal egg production; no external structure
gui.mekanism_magic.animal_spawner.limit: Nearby entity counts do not affect this machine
gui.mekanism_magic.animal_spawner.blocke: Spawn egg output full or incompatible
jei.mekanism_magic.animal_spawner.struct: Creates spawn eggs internally without an external foundation, spawn space or nearby entity checks
jei.mekanism_magic.animal_spawner.select: For identical inputs with multiple targets, select the saved target in the machine screen
gui.mekanism_magic.hephaestus.core_outpu: Empty core slot to install upgrade
tooltip.mekanism_magic.hephaestus.slot.c: Native Hephaestus Forge core. Supply the original tier-up ritual materials to upgrade it here, one tier at a time. Its tier determines rituals and essence capacities.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.hephaestus.core_e: The upgrading core is held safely inside the machine and installed when ready. New cores cannot be inserted meanwhile; remove spare old cores to leave the slot empty.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.hephaestus.slot.s: Ritual starter. Native blacksmith gavels use 50 durability per ritual; enchantments and modifiers still apply.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.hephaestus.slot.m: Main ingredient. One item is paid when the ritual starts.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.hephaestus.slot.a: Ritual ingredients. Use any of the eight slots; native ingredient amounts are matched without a fixed order.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.hephaestus.slot.o: Completed ritual results. Items can be extracted automatically.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.hephaestus.slot.e: Essence input. Insert native essence items or filled essence containers; stacked containers are processed one at a time.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.hephaestus.slot.w: Single container being drained. Can be removed manually; item automation cannot insert or extract here.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.hephaestus.slot.r: Returned empty containers and separately worn tools. Items can be extracted automatically.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.hephaestus.enhanc: Enhancer slot %s: inactive; stored items have no effect
The installed forge enables the first %s slots, up to four. Enhancers are retained.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.item_modifier.inp: Place the target item, native modifier smithing template and addition in any order, one role per slot. One of each is consumed. Items with any existing modifier cannot receive another.
tooltip.mekanism_magic.item_modifier.out: Native modified result, retaining target data according to the original modifier rules. Can be extracted automatically. Templates and additions are consumed; no extra containers are returned.
